rules.rationale: Main-group oxides: deep O 2p valence band and empty cation s states maximize the optical gap.
Closed-shell ionic halides have the largest electronegativity contrast, pushing the conduction band up.
Partially filled d states insert mid-gap bands and lower measured optical gaps broadly.
Heavier chalcogen p states raise the valence-band maximum, narrowing the semiconducting gap.

skills.hypothesis: Closed-shell anion ionicity and d-band filling set the gap direction. Fails for lanthanide f-state compounds and for defect-narrowed halide reports where the nominal anion overstates the true gap.

rules.rationale: Source gave +9.23 on refractive index to metalloids, but the inverted gap prior is uncertain and is heavily shrunk.
Halogen-dominant source effect was strongly negative (-3.74 on n); gap prior kept small given low transfer weight.
Heavy-Z bin raised source refractive index (+6.07); diffuse orbitals weaken bonding-antibonding splitting and shrink the gap.
Very heavy mean Z implies relativistic valence broadening consistent with narrow measured gaps.

skills.hypothesis: Transferred dielectric information only weakly predicts gaps; keeping the Moss-inverted magnitudes small and letting the target-only anchor dominate is safer. May lose when target gap tracks source polarizability closely.

lesson: Both prior skills were seed-unstable: each hit near-zero AUC on one seed while the other scored 93, so the mean difference is not evidence of a real ranking advantage. The d-state and closed-shell rules carry the interpretable signal; source dielectric transfer stayed the weaker path.
revision_summary: Retained the closed-shell ionicity skill, streamlined to four mechanistic rules on anion family and transition-metal flag. Replaced the direct Moss sign-flip skill with an explicitly shrunk counter-hypothesis that downweights every transferred source effect, since the source transfer weights were all below 0.03 and both prior skills failed on the same near-zero seed. Deployment selection stays with the domain-knowledge, non-transfer skill but with lower semantic mass to limit damage from unstable seeds.
